governing_rule: These approvals authorize detailed numeric specification and testing only. No exact equation, weight, threshold, cap, purchase rule, production forecast, or UIP delivery is authorized until separately reviewed and approved.

conditions: Applies only to products routed to DIRECT_HISTORY_CALIBRATED.
Historical maturity is not a universal forecast eligibility gate.
Products with insufficient mature history remain eligible through approved DIRECT_HISTORY_LIMITED, COMPARABLE_PRODUCT_ADJUSTED, or FUNDAMENTAL_COMPARABLE_HYBRID routes.
Lack of mature history alone must not cause the platform to miss an otherwise supportable early investment opportunity.
Limited direct history is a minority input.
Approved comparables are the primary input until the product qualifies for calibrated history.
Exact weights remain subject to separate numeric approval.
Peer contributions must remain individually disclosed.
Exact weighting equations remain subject to separate numeric approval.
The approved same-set comparable remains the dominant evidence source.
Exact comparable and fundamental weights remain subject to separate numeric approval.
Scenario width and confidence must reflect actual evidence quality, dispersion, agreement, and limitations.
Exact equations and class thresholds remain subject to separate numeric approval.
Supply, demand, liquidity, and reprint effects must be separately disclosed.
Exact adjustment scales and bounds remain subject to separate numeric approval.

approvals.approved_concept: Data-derived review gates and purchase analysis development
conditions: The intended operating state is daily data refresh so stale-price risk is minimized.
Freshness diagnostics and fail-closed behavior must still exist when a daily refresh fails or data is unavailable.
No hard forecast caps are authorized.
Extreme forecasts must remain visible and be routed to enhanced review rather than silently clipped.
Purchase-analysis calculations may be developed and backtested.
No purchase thresholds, recommendations, or authorizations may activate without separate owner approval.

next_stage_authorized: Prepare exact numerical equations, weights, thresholds, and diagnostics for owner review.
Implement candidate calculations in non-production mode.
Prepare a separate exact numeric specification approval package.
not_authorized: Automatic disqualification based only on insufficient mature history
